title: Published integrated two-layer Richards authority reconciliation

sources.citation: He, J., Hantush, M.M., Kalin, L., Rezaeianzadeh, M., Isik, S. (2021). A two-layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model development. Journal of Hydrology 602, 126797.
He, J., Hantush, M.M., Kalin, L., Isik, S. (2022). Two-Layer numerical model of soil moisture dynamics: Model assessment and Bayesian uncertainty estimation. Journal of Hydrology 613A, 128327.
Corrigendum to the 2022 assessment paper. Journal of Hydrology 613A, 128424.

model_identity.capillary_head: psi is positive suction / negative of pressure head
state: theta_bar_1: thickness-averaged water content of upper layer
theta_bar_2: thickness-averaged water content of lower vadose layer
model_identity.fixed_H_specialization: For fixed H, dH/dt=0 and the lower equation is an ordinary fixed-control-volume balance.
model_identity.zero_pressure_head_bottom_flux: q2 = Ks2 * [1 + 2*(psi_b-psi_bar_2)/(H-h)], with psi_b=0 for the shallow-water-table tests

2021: Three representative homogeneous soil textures compared against HYDRUS-1D.
Layer-averaged water contents and cumulative fluxes generally agreed well with HYDRUS.
Dynamic-water-table desaturation scenario demonstrated moving-H formulation.
2022: 231 soil textures and varying upper/lower layer thicknesses.
Field-scale SCAN application with Bayesian calibration/uncertainty analysis.
Performance degrades with thicker lower vadose zones and, especially under shallow-water-table conditions, coarse textures.
Authors explicitly identify the approximations psi_bar≈psi(theta_bar) and K_bar≈K(theta_bar) and first-order truncation as major structural error sources.
validation_evidence.purpose: The literature evaluates layer-mean moisture and fluxes rather than pointwise profile identity, matching F-ROMV2 purpose-dependent fidelity.

relation_to_swap5_candidates.D5_L2_IMC: Not a reproduction. D5 used two dynamic 80-cm averages but direct instantaneous Darcy gradients and harmonic conductivities.
relation_to_swap5_candidates.D7_QS1: Not a reproduction. D7 used one dynamic total-storage coordinate plus quasi-steady profile reconstruction.
relation_to_swap5_candidates.D8_QS2_COMPOSITE: Not a reproduction. D8 used two independently conserved segment storages with quasi-steady subprofile reconstruction.
relation_to_swap5_candidates.He_model_distinction: The published model derives the interface flux analytically from vertically integrated Richards balances and first-order/Taylor approximations of layer-average head and conductivity.

faithful_fixed_geometry_subset.root_sink: zero for the first hydraulic reproduction
faithful_fixed_geometry_subset.top_boundary: prescribed flux only in first reproduction
bottom_boundaries: zero-pressure head h_pressure=0 cm / psi_b=0, faithful shallow-water-table published case
free drainage only if current research Reference seam exposes the same physical boundary without source mutation
faithful_fixed_geometry_subset.time_integration: iterative Heun, epsilon_theta=1e-4; same declared forcing interval as the SWAP5 comparator unless a separate time-step sensitivity workunit is preregistered

unsupported_as_faithful_without_extensio: arbitrary nonzero unsaturated prescribed bottom pressure head, including the current D/V h≈-30 cm challenge values
claims for SWAP-specific runoff/ponding/root uptake/frost/macropore/oxygen processes
heterogeneous B01/B14 transfer without separate authority

extension_firewall.arbitrary_prescribed_head: A mathematically natural replacement of Ks at the lower boundary by K(psi_b), or any other generalized prescribed-head expression, is not labeled a faithful He et al. reproduction unless directly supported by primary source authority.
extension_firewall.current_DV_histories: The existing D01-D08/V01-V04 mixed-head workload cannot by itself serve as a faithful full-envelope reproduction test because its nonzero prescribed bottom heads lie outside the clearly validated zero-head/free-drainage literature envelope.
extension_firewall.successor: First test the faithful published zero-head subset. Only if scientifically useful may a separately named HE2_SWAPH extension be preregistered for arbitrary prescribed head.

next_authority.authorized_task: Implement an evidence-only faithful fixed-H, zero-sink, homogeneous-B01 two-layer comparator using the published interface and zero-pressure-head bottom flux equations and iterative Heun corrector.
next_authority.comparison_reference: Current-canonical R16 Reference route under matched top-flux forcing and zero-pressure-head lower boundary.
